regions.merged_text: I just read the photo you sent me of our dear Father M. E. Joachim's tomb-marker and, sitting here with my two feet on another chair am using it as a writing desk. Deo gratias. I've not said holy Mass since last Thursday. The skin-burns I wrote you about last week (if it got off), started the eczema activity again - after I'd had a Dr. Stan Casey treat the former. He sent me to a skin- specialist in Ft. Wayne, Dr. McNairy, who stresses with treatment, "feet up." I would have offered holy Mass yesterday but Fr. Guardian thought better keep to Dr.'s orders. So that will probably mean a week or so before I'm on my feet again properly. Thanks be to God is gives me comparatively little pain or itch; so that time does not hang so painfully as it might otherwise.
